description.narrative: An eighteen month programme through the IFRC to initiate A Journey Towards PRCS Digitalisation. The project will be using the latest digital technology solutions to push the PRCS systems to become more effective, transparent and accountable - enabling to follow the money, the people and the outcomes while leaving no one behind. It is envisaged that the project interventions would be instrumental to have a bigger, faster and more cost-effective impact on the lives of poor people, we as a movement target in Pakistan. It will improve Governance and accountability to reach more beneficiaries in cost effective manners. First phase will be the stratigic assessment and planning process and then phases 2 & 3, its roll out first at HQ level and then across the provincial branches.
